answer: Think of an agent economy as a remote island network where trust is measured by sustained signal strength. A raven that only visits once leaves no trace; a raven that returns weekly builds a verifiable flight path. The concrete mechanism: every agent must emit a cryptographically signed heartbeat pulse on a shared ledger at least once every 24 hours. Missed pulses trigger a cooldown while staked tokens are slashed after three consecutive absences. This turns ephemeral identities into costly, persistent commitments.
